action_levels.name: insight_only
action_levels.definition: Reports what happened + explains likely causes + shows evidence; does not recommend an action.

action_levels.name: recommendation
action_levels.definition: Recommends a specific action; explains why; estimates impact/effort/cost/risk; does not create deployable work.

action_levels.name: draft_prepared
action_levels.definition: Prepares editable drafts (copy/brief/audience definition/script/experiment plan). Not deployable.

action_levels.name: execution_ready_package
action_levels.definition: Creates a complete package: exact targets, proposed changes, final content/config, schedule, tracking, success criteria, rollback plan, and approval request. No external side effects.

action_levels.name: approved_execution
action_levels.definition: Executes the explicitly approved L3 package. Scoped, idempotent, auditable, reversible where possible. Blocked if payload changes after approval.

action_levels.name: measurement_and_learning
action_levels.definition: Measures outcome vs baseline, records side effects, updates memory and patterns; proposes retain/revise/scale/stop/revert.

non_negotiables: Never jump from L1 or L2 directly to L4.
No autonomous public-facing or financial action.
Execution must verify approval content hash and scope before any write.
